text:
ana: quick pulse after the EU hotspot yesterday. proposing an orchestration layer (we're calling it 'geo-orchestra') to make detours deterministic and auditable. short idea dump.
lee: love the name. what's the difference vs current proxy rules?
ana: current = brittle ACLs and inline fallbacks. geo-orchestra = single decision API + policy engine + local proxy cache. responsibilities: policy eval, target ranking, prewarm hints, and audit tokens.
ravi: policy engine sounds heavy. must be O(1) for the hot path. suggest: deterministic policy eval function + small LRU cache in proxy with 500ms TTL.
nina: legal/consent constraints: detours that move resident data must surface a consent_token. geo-orchestra should return consent_required=true so proxy can block or prompt.
ana: proposal: admission flow: proxy -> orchestra.decide(headers) -> response includes decision (local|detour|reject), decision_token, target_region(s), model_action (none|downgrade:pair_id), prewarm_hint (prefixes:list), reason_code. proxy enforces by token.
lee: token solves idempotency and auditing. include HMAC so runtime can verify. good.
ravi: cache prewarm: only for top-K prefixes and only when historic_detour_rate > threshold. prewarm jobs must be rate-limited.
nina: also require tenant-config flags: allow_detour (opt-in), allowed_downgrades (list of pairs), allow_prefetch (bool), consent_token_policy. store as versioned config.
a na: small API sketch (headers simplified):
"GET /v1/decide?tenant=acme&model=llama-13b"
Response headers: X-Decide-Decision: detour
X-Decide-Target: us-west-2
X-Decide-Token: dtok_abc123.hmac
X-Decide-Model-Action: downgrade:pair42
X-Decide-Prewarm: prefix:login, prefix:profile
X-Decide-Reason: capacity
X-Decide-TTL: 30

lee: runtime integration: serve runtime should echo X-Decide-Token in logs. console can reconcile tokens -> decisions -> quality signals.
ravi: failure modes: orchestra outage -> proxies fallback to local conservative policy (no downgrades, only cold-forward if consented). mark this in SLA docs.
nina: consent flow: if consent_required, proxy returns 451-like error to SDK with instruction to surface opt-in prompt in client. legal-team to draft UX language.
ops-bot: quick canary started: namespace=geo-orchestra-stg traffic=2% will report metrics in 7m.
ana: metrics we need during canary: decide_rpc_latency, decide_cache_hit, detour_applied_count, model_downgrades, kv_prefetch_jobs, detour_quality_delta (semantic-similarity), customer-visible-complaints.
lee: add metric: detour_hop_count and detour_retries (if target saturated).
ravi: backoff policy: try primary target -> if saturated, try next up to N=2 hops. avoid circular reroute by refusing targets that previously returned 'reject' in same decision chain.
nina: edge-case: long-running chats with KV state. admission-only detour is enforced; for ongoing sessions we must not swap model mid-session. define session-boundary token in orchestra response.
a na: i'll draft the RFC follow-up 'geo-orchestra-detour' with interfaces, tenant-config schema, and failure-handling. lee/ravi/nina volunteer to review.
ops-bot: canary partial metrics: p50_decide=4ms p95=18ms, cache_hit=72%, detours=42, avg_latency_delta=+22ms, prewarm_jobs=6.
lee: good signal. schedule 1-hour canary and collect semantic-eval on sample prompts.
ravi: i'll prototype the proxy LRU and HMAC token verification.
nina: i'll sync legal on consent wording and tenant opt-in defaults.
a na: thanks. tagging reviewers in RFC when ready. reconvene after 1h canary. :calendar:
